decisions.reason: The daily output cadence does not change the existing approval authority, approval gate, or quota-counting rule.
The cadence for producing monthly clips does not change the future Lead Clipper pathway or responsibilities.
The daily cadence applies to ongoing monthly production after hiring and does not modify the qualification process.
Production cadence does not alter the requirement that each clip contain a complete standalone teaching moment.
The roughly 3-4-clips-per-day cadence does not change the independently stated 45-60-second duration requirement.
Daily output volume does not change which source videos may be used.
The monthly production cadence does not establish or change a submission channel or review-submission procedure.
The cadence change does not alter the existing rule for publishing approved clips to the dedicated Instagram account.
The required daily output volume does not modify clean-editing, effects, or transition standards.
The cadence change has no necessary effect on caption color, font, or effects.
The number of clips expected per day does not change the independent standard for selecting strong source moments.
